summary: The Backrooms: Level 0 is a multiplayer survival game in a seeded maze, with a safe hub, smilers, almond-water and melee-weapon pickups, sanity, and leveling. world.config.yaml wires player/camera, controls and HUD; places/main contains the maze scene and its referee, while shared maze and tuning data keep gameplay and geometry aligned.
places: places/main (default place, 3D) - the Level 0 maze and safe hub; its nine cell scenes place the maze mesh, hub props, smiler manager and many lights, while places/main/sim.js replenishes almond water, smilers and floor weapons.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer game entry: selects main, camera/player templates, lighting, arrival behavior, controls (including E to cycle weapons), HUD and nametags.
templates/player.js - player body template; runs humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, with character physics and player tag.
templates/camera.js - custom first-person camera template; scripts/camera.js implements its look-oriented yaw/pitch rig.
places/main/config.yaml - 3D place setup: fog and ambient lighting, default spawn at origin, gravity -24; terrain is off.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - main authored scene: hub/cot/lamp/table/sign, level0 mesh, almond props, light group and smiler-pack.
places/main/cells/x-1z-1.scene, x-1z0.scene, x-1z1.scene, x0z-1.scene, x0z1.scene, x1z-1.scene, x1z0.scene, x1z1.scene - surrounding light placements completing the cell-partitioned place.
sim.js - world-level cadence/tick entry, currently an empty referee; places/main/sim.js has the active Level 0 replenishment logic.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js - canonical seeded 36x36, 4m-cell layout: zones, cell/world coordinates, walls, arches, pits, pillars and exit; used by level mesh, player, smilers and place sim.
scripts/lib/data/level0.yml - central Level 0 tuning for maze dimensions, survival stats, XP, combat and spawn counts/timers; consumed by maze, player, smilers and place sim.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml - melee weapon order, names/stats/level requirements and floor pickup count/refill interval; consumed by player, HUD and place sim, with weapon-geo reading kind parameters.
scripts/lib/data/player.yml and scripts/lib/data/camera.yml - shared humanoid movement/turn defaults and first-person eye height, consumed by locomotion and camera scripts.
scripts/lib/shapes.js - face/tube/sphere mesh helpers reused by scripted creature and prop geometry.
notableExports: scripts/lib/maze.js - exports N, hash, inHub, zoneOf, cellCenter, cellAt, zoneAt, wallX, wallZ, isArchWall, hasPit, hasPillar (also hasLight, EXIT, ZONE_NAMES)
scripts/player.js - exports maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, onInput, update
scripts/camera.js - exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/level0-geo.js - exports geometry
scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js and scripts/weapon-geo.js - export geometry, collider
scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - each exports default renderer; scripts/lighting.js exports lighting; scripts/arrival.js exports onArrive, onLeave
ownership: scripts/player.js - each player's state owns level, XP, HP, sanity, stamina, battery, almond count, visited-cell/zone tracking, kills, deaths, weapon collection/equipped weapon and transient HUD timestamps; its session holds local movement, flashlight and cooldown scratch.
scripts/smilers.js - each smiler's state carries HP/dead; per-smiler session memory tracks prey, path/stalk and bite timing; the manager handles movement and destroys dead smilers.
places/main/sim.js - place.state owns almond/smiler/weapon seeded flags and next-refill times; it queries live tagged entities and spawns replacements.
scripts/camera.js - camera state owns yaw and pitch; templates/camera.js initializes both to zero.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - body state provides shared turn/seat fields; its gait smoothing, clip and measured-pace scratch is namespaced in body session.
scripts/ui.js - owns no gameplay state; renders from player.state and world input labels, including the equipped weapon.
flows: world.config.yaml inputs (moveX/moveZ, jump, sprint, attack, drink, flashlight, cycleWeapon) → templates/player.js behavior chain → humanoid-locomotion.js turns/animates the body, then scripts/player.js handles movement and survival/combat/weapon selection.
world.config.yaml camera template → scripts/camera.js consumes look orientation and writes camera yaw/pitch; player input uses aim yaw axes to set its movement direction.
scripts/player.js changes player.state survival/level/zone and equipped weapon values → scripts/ui.js reads player.state and scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml to render the HUD.
scripts/player.js attack → tagged smiler.state.hp/dead; scripts/smilers.js reads those fields and removes dead entities with effects.
scripts/smilers.js selects players from ctx.place.players and writes prey HP/sanity → player.state read by scripts/ui.js; per-player damage effects are emitted to that player's audience.

places/main/sim.js (cadence 1s) queries almond/smiler/weapon tags and reads level0.yml/weapons.yml → spawns almond, smiler and kind-parameterized weapon entities; place.state tracks seeded/refill timers.
scripts/player.js reads scripts/lib/maze.js zone/cell/exit helpers for survival, XP and exit behavior; scripts/smilers.js uses the same maze layout for movement/targeting.
scripts/level0-geo.js reads scripts/lib/maze.js → one placed scripted mesh whose walls, arches, pits and pillars match the gameplay layout; cell scenes place the companion level0-lights group.
world.config.yaml engine.behaviors → scripts/arrival.js onArrive/onLeave; both handlers are currently empty.
world.config.yaml ui.render → scripts/ui.js for the player's HUD; world.config.yaml nametag → ui/nametag.js for other-player labels.
world.config.yaml lighting → scripts/lighting.js shades lit surfaces from engine-provided lighting; places/main atmosphere.look → scripts/look-default.js.
scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js and scripts/weapon-geo.js → scripts/lib/shapes.js helpers for scripted meshes; almond props are also authored in the hub.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* level0-lights/l* - many authored light placements across all nine cells; ordinary warm panels vary from red-zone lights, with coordinates corresponding to maze cells.

scripts/almond-geo.js, scripts/smiler-geo.js and scripts/weapon-geo.js - scripted prop/creature meshes share scripts/lib/shapes.js primitives; weapon-geo varies its rod by weapon kind and is spawned dynamically, while hub almond props are fixed.

templates/player.js behavior chain - humanoid-locomotion.js is deliberately before player.js so gait reads the body's prior movement; player.js then writes the walker's velocity and survival behavior.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - no current place references it; main terrain is explicitly off.

scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js, scripts/reed.js - vegetation/layer scripts have no active terrain layer in places/main/config.yaml (terrain is off) and no current placement references.
migrationNotes: scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/data/level0.yml are a coupled layout contract: keep seeded cell/zone rules consistent wherever mesh, lamps, player location logic, smiler paths or spawning are changed.
Maze coordinates use 36 cells at 4 metres each; world positions are derived by cellCenter/cellAt around HALF, and maze wall height is 3 metres.
The hub spans indices 16–19 on both axes and is the safe room; the mesh doorway, zone logic and smiler restrictions depend on this shared definition.
The player template order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js precedes player.js; reversing it changes which velocity locomotion animation reads.
Player HUD and collected weapons belong to player.state; local control scratch belongs under the script's own key in player.session; smiler AI scratch is likewise session data, not shared state.
scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml order and keys are shared by player weapon cycling, weapon pickup spawning and weapon-geo kind params; floor weapon state.kind must remain one of those keys.
